questions.question_text: A gym charges a \$30 joining fee plus \$15 per month. Which function gives $C$, the total cost in dollars, for $x$ months of membership?

options.why: Swapped the fixed fee and the monthly rate, charging \$30 each month.
Added the \$30 and \$15 together and multiplied the total by $x$.
Made the \$30 joining fee the per-month charge and \$15 the one-off fee.

questions.solution_text:
The \$30 joining fee is fixed, and each of the $x$ months adds \$15.
$C(x)=30+15x$

questions.question_text: Translate the statement “the y-coordinate when x=5” into mathematics.

options.why: Represents the gradient at 5, not the y-coordinate.
